in_english.name: Imaad
in_english.meaning: Imaad is an Islamic name that means listener, obedient to Allah's word
in_english.long_meaning: Imaad is an Islamic name that means listener, obedient to Allah's word, and is derived from the Arabic root 'im-' meaning to listen or obey. In Islamic tradition, Imaad is considered a name of excellence, as it denotes one who is attentive to Allah's words and commands. The name Imaad is also associated with traits such as humility, modesty, and a strong sense of justice. In Islamic theology, Imaad is seen as a reflection of the believer's commitment to following Allah's guidance and adhering to His will.
